note: Literature notes progressive coarsening of facial features and changing craniofacial gestalt with age in CdLS, supporting non-classic adult phenotypes in cohesinopathies.

evidence.text: It has been reported that the facial features of Cornelia de Lange syndrome evolve over time, specifically showing progressive coarsening of the eyebrows, eyes, and prognathism, while distinct gene-specific facial patterns emerge across causative loci.
